text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Real-time p99 latency spike detected for /v1/generate in us-east-1. p95=780ms, p99=3.6s. SLO violated (p99 target 2.0s). Detected at 2026-02-18T14:04:48Z. Paging rotation: oncall-rotation
alex: ack — I’m on it. landing in #incidents. grabbing dashboard
maria: looking at Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/latency/serving?orgId=1&var-region=us-east-1 — p99 jump aligns with an uptick in streaming stalls and batcher queue length
sahil: FYI there's a kernel module update rolled out to a subset of dedicated nodes ~14:00UTC, could be related
lee: any customer-facing errors? checking logs now
maria: query to check streaming stalls:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM streaming_events WHERE event='stall' AND region='us-east-1' AND ts > now() - interval '10 minutes';
```
maria: results — stalls increased ~6x vs baseline, most from model=rwd-7b-quant, batcher_queue>50
alex: running quick cURL smoke to a smaller model and same route
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","input":"hi"}' | jq '.time_ms'
```
alex: rwd-3b p99 ~190ms — so route degradation seems model/instance-specific
sahil: checking instance metadata — kernel patch landed on dedicated pool ids [dp-42, dp-43], those have elevated io wait
ops-bot: deployment rollback requested: rollback kernel module to previous version on dp-42, dp-43 — ticket created OPS-4987
lee: @maria can you snapshot batcher metrics + KV cache hit rate for the last 30m
maria: kv_cache_hit dropped from 0.92 -> 0.61 after 14:00UTC. suggests cache thrash
alex: immediate mitigation idea: 1) route new requests away from dp-42/43 to other pools 2) enable small-model fallback for lat-sensitive routes 3) throttle long-running streaming sessions
carmen: I'll start routing changes and toggle fallback. taking over incident ops in 10m
maria: added a temporary query-level cache for common prefixes (TTL 30s) as a shallow mitigation
sahil: infra telemetry shows network drops on dp-43 NIC around 14:03 — correlating with kernel module net driver change
alex: customer impact estimate: ~3% of live requests in us-east-1 saw p99 > SLO during window; large streaming customers may observe stalls. No data exfiltration or 5xx spike
lee: can we notify support to prepare a status page blurb? minimal impact note, investigating
alex: drafted status update for support:
"We are investigating elevated latency for text-generation in us-east-1. Our on-call team is performing mitigations (routing and rollbacks). Some users may see slower streaming responses. We'll update within 30 minutes."
carmen: mitigation actions in flight: routing rule applied to avoid dp-42/43, rollback initiated, fallback to rwd-3b enabled for /v1/generate latency-sensitive route
maria: dashboards now show p99 trending down after routing change (14:08UTC). stalls decreased ~60%
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-089 — severity: P2 — owner: carmen
sahil: will follow up with kernel team for root-cause; leaving notes in OPS ticket about net driver regression
carmen: I'll monitor for 30m and then hand off to infra oncall. if p99 remains below 2.0s and stalls subside handoff at 14:40UTC
alex: thx team. Next steps: infra RCA, permanent patch rollback or driver fix, evaluate KV cache tuning to avoid thrash. I'll open a postmortem stub.
carmen: taking over from alex — ping me if anything spikes. starting 30m watch
oncall-rotation: acknowledged — rotation updated to carmen. paging cleared
ops-bot: summary saved to /incidents/INC-2026-089/summary.txt
